name: Deemix
description: Deemix is a Deezer music downloader with a web interface, in the maintained community fork by bambanah. It downloads tracks, albums, playlists and discographies from Deezer with tags and cover art, in MP3 or FLAC depending on the account.

notes.text: Downloading needs your Deezer ARL: copy the arl cookie from deezer.com in your browser's developer tools and paste it under Settings > Login > Log in with ARL. It expires after about three months.
Deemix has no login and uses the saved ARL for every visitor. Keep port 6595 on a trusted network or behind an authenticating reverse proxy.
Music is saved to /opt/deemix_data/music. For a NAS, bind-mount the share there with pct set <CTID> -mp0; in an unprivileged container the host directory must be writable by UID 100000.
